All original unconfirmed/failed control records are preserved. Initial恏positive reference was a method error, corrected before accepting any source result.

Control-only bounded outlier selection may remove at most1reference per side, retain>=2per side and require all remaining LOO tests to pass; actual source score does not choose calibration set. Explicit removed labels retained.
First差 uses finite early-fall timing because phrase-final first-tone lowering and fourth-tone early fall are blurred by DTW. Scope is this pair under declared same-voice controls.

曾uses affricate-release to fixed-CC detected-periodicity timing, corroborated by inspected frication/voicing. Detector onset is15–30ms later than visual vowel onset, so this is a relative same-method proxy, not laboratory absolute VOT.
